scenarios.prompt: A project uses fatigue and temperature with different threshold effects. Define a versioned needs policy and timebase.

criteria.policy: needs_policy_id/revision, meters and threshold/effect policy are explicit.
criteria.time: Timebase plus pause/suspend/fast-forward behavior are explicit.
criteria.idempotency: Consumption/tick identities prevent duplicate state changes and HUD is not canonical truth.
